DECISION
DECISION: Unknown commands/tools trigger approval request instead of auto-approving
OPTIONS: Auto-approve unknown (lenient) vs require approval (strict)
REASONING: Ned explicitly asked for unknown = ask. If it's not in the safe list, he wants to see it.
IMPLEMENTATION: Changed fallthrough in classifySingleCommand() and classifyTool() from needsApproval: false to needsApproval: true for any command/tool not found in SAFE_COMMANDS, RISKY_COMMANDS, or KNOWN_TOOLS
REVISIT WHEN: If too many legitimate tools get flagged and become annoying
